```{=html}
<style>
.w112-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w112-dd .w112-buckets { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w112-dd .w112-bucket {
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  padding: 8px; min-height: 150px; cursor: pointer;
}
.w112-dd .w112-bucket h5 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 0.95rem; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; }
.w112-dd .w112-bucket.w112-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w112-dd .w112-pool {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w112-dd .w112-item {
  display: block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: grab;
  user-select: none; border: 1.5px solid #d81e2e; color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem;
  margin: 3px 0; text-align: center;
}
.w112-dd .w112-pool .w112-item { margin: 0; }
.w112-dd .w112-item.w112-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w112-dd .w112-item.w112-right { border-color: #2e7d32; border-width: 2px; }
.w112-dd .w112-item.w112-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; border-width: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #d81e2e inset; }
.w112-dd .w112-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w112-dd button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w112-dd .w112-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w112-dd .w112-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w112-dd .w112-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w112-dd .w112-note { font-size: 0.78rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.7; }
.w112-dd .w112-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w112-dd iw" id="w112-dd">
  <div class="w112-pool" aria-label="situations to classify"></div>
  <div class="w112-buckets">
    <div class="w112-bucket" data-cat="raid"><h5>RAID handles it</h5></div>
    <div class="w112-bucket" data-cat="backup"><h5>Only a backup handles it</h5></div>
  </div>
  <div class="w112-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w112-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w112-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w112-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w112-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w112-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w112-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    RAID buys <em>uptime</em> through hardware failure: it keeps the service running
    when a disk fails, even while the disk is swapped. But a mirror or parity array
    copies a deletion, corruption or ransomware encryption instantly and exactly to
    every disk, so returning to an earlier state - or surviving the loss of the whole
    site - needs the separate point-in-time copy a backup provides - see
    <a href="#sec-11-backup">the section on backup</a> and
    <a href="#tbl-raidbackup">the RAID-versus-backup table</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w112-dd');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w112-pool');
  const buckets = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w112-bucket')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w112-msg');
  const ITEMS = [
    { id: 'i0', cat: 'raid',   text: 'A single disk fails and the service must keep running' },
    { id: 'i1', cat: 'backup', text: 'An administrator deletes the wrong directory' },
    { id: 'i2', cat: 'backup', text: 'Ransomware encrypts the live data' },
    { id: 'i3', cat: 'raid',   text: 'A failed disk is swapped while the array keeps operating' },
    { id: 'i4', cat: 'backup', text: 'The system must return to an earlier point in time' },
    { id: 'i5', cat: 'backup', text: 'The whole site is lost' }
  ];
  let picked = null;

  function makeItem(it) {
    const c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'w112-item';
    c.textContent = it.text;
    c.dataset.id = it.id;
    c.dataset.cat = it.cat;
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement !== pool) { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); return; }
      if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
      unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w112-picked');
      buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.add('w112-armed'));
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', it.id));
    return c;
  }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w112-picked');
    picked = null;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w112-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w112-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('w112-right', 'w112-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w112-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(bucket, item) { bucket.appendChild(item); clearMarks(); }
  buckets.forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(b, picked); unpick(); } });
    b.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    b.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const item = root.querySelector('.w112-item[data-id="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
      if (item) { place(b, item); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const item = root.querySelector('.w112-item[data-id="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
    if (item) { pool.appendChild(item); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w112-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0;
    const unplaced = pool.querySelectorAll('.w112-item').length;
    buckets.forEach(b => {
      b.querySelectorAll('.w112-item').forEach(i => {
        i.classList.remove('w112-right', 'w112-wrong');
        if (i.dataset.cat === b.dataset.cat) { i.classList.add('w112-right'); right++; }
        else { i.classList.add('w112-wrong'); wrong++; }
      });
    });
    if (right === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct - RAID buys uptime through hardware failure, backup recovers from everything else.'; msg.className = 'w112-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (unplaced > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going - ' + unplaced + ' situation(s) still unsorted.'; msg.className = 'w112-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet - the red items sit in the wrong box. Remember: a mirror copies the damage exactly.'; msg.className = 'w112-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w112-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    root.querySelectorAll('.w112-item').forEach(c => {
      const bucket = buckets.find(b => b.dataset.cat === c.dataset.cat);
      if (bucket) place(bucket, c);
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('.w112-item').forEach(c => c.classList.add('w112-right'));
    root.querySelector('.w112-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w112-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  root.querySelector('.w112-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w112-item').forEach(i => pool.appendChild(i));
    root.querySelector('.w112-expl').hidden = true;
    unpick(); clearMarks();
  });
  ITEMS.forEach(it => pool.appendChild(makeItem(it)));
})();
</script>
```
